moduleTitle: Module 1. Foundations, Membranes and Cell Signaling
topicSummary: Membrane Structure and Diffusion. 7 competencies, week 2.

competencies.name: Membrane composition and fluidity
competencies.can: Describe the fluid mosaic membrane and state how phospholipids, cholesterol, glycolipids, and integral and peripheral proteins contribute to its properties.

competencies.name: Determinants of permeability
competencies.can: Rank molecules by their ability to cross a lipid bilayer unaided using size, charge, and lipid solubility, and predict which will require a protein.

competencies.name: Simple diffusion and Fick's law
competencies.can: State the variables in Fick's law of diffusion and predict how a change in concentration gradient, surface area, membrane thickness, or distance changes the rate of transfer.

competencies.name: Osmolarity and tonicity
competencies.can: Calculate the osmolarity of a solution, distinguish osmolarity from tonicity, and classify a solution as isotonic, hypotonic, or hypertonic to a cell.

competencies.name: Osmosis and cell volume
competencies.can: Predict the direction of water movement and the resulting change in cell volume when a cell is placed in a solution of stated osmolarity and penetrating solute content.

competencies.name: Diffusion and osmosis experiment
competencies.can: Measure diffusion and osmotic movement across a selectively permeable membrane and relate the observed rate to molecular size and concentration gradient.

competencies.name: Tonicity and red blood cells
competencies.can: Observe erythrocytes in solutions of different tonicity, identify crenation, normal shape, and hemolysis, and explain each result.
